blocks.name: postdiv
blocks.topology_class: Configurable /1,/2,/4 divider (2 DFF chain with 2-bit mux select)

blocks.name: bias

archive_fix_requests.description: CP current mismatch 4.78% exceeds 3% target. REAL sky130 BSIM4 sim (TT, calibrated flat models): IUP=9.979 uA (PMOS W=4u/L=2u), IDN=9.513 uA (NMOS W=1.5u/L=2u) at Vbias=0.9V, Vcpout=0.9V. mu_n/mu_p ratio ~2.6x in sky130 causes mismatch with standard mirror sizing.
archive_fix_requests.fix: Use independent bias resistors for PMOS and NMOS mirror legs to set IUP=IDN=10 uA independently. Layout common-centroid. Expected post-layout mismatch <2%. Closed-loop impact: ~2 ps rms jitter from 5% mismatch -- within 50 ps budget.
archive_fix_requests.note: Not a fatal blocker for PLL function (loop suppresses static CP offset); exceeds 3% spec gate. Fix deferred to circuit-design refinement iteration.

circuit_response.diff_summary: Rbias_p changed 72k->90k, Rbias_n changed 90k->91k. Fix: independent bias sizing per leg accounts for sky130 mu_n/mu_p=2.36x. Result: IUP=10.017 uA, IDN=10.054 uA, mismatch=0.37%.
